user.title: Connect I-Digital SMS
user.description: Enter the Direct API key, sender name and one fixed E.164 recipient. Setup only checks local input format and does not contact the provider or send a test SMS. The provider account may charge for every sent part; the reported free test-number allowance has not been verified for your account.

error.invalid_api_key: Enter the Direct API key in its supplied Base64 form.
error.invalid_recipient: Enter one E.164 phone number, for example +79990000000.
error.invalid_message: The SMS text must not be empty.
error.message_too_long: The SMS exceeds one provider billing part. Shorten the text before sending.
error.duplicate_suppressed: An identical SMS was attempted recently. Wait five minutes before sending it again.
error.rate_limited: SMS sending is limited to one message per minute and ten messages per hour.
error.provider_rejected: I-Digital rejected the SMS. Check the sender, recipient and account rules.
error.unknown_outcome: The send result is unknown. Do not retry automatically. If a message UUID is available, check its status; otherwise ask the account owner or I-Digital to check the provider history before sending again.
error.storage_error: SMS retry protection could not be saved. Sending is blocked to prevent duplicates.
error.guard_capacity: The unresolved SMS attempt limit was reached. Sending is blocked until the stored attempts are reviewed.
error.invalid_message_uuid: Enter the message UUID returned by I-Digital.
error.status_unavailable: I-Digital status is unavailable. Try one explicit status check later.

get_status.name: Get SMS status
get_status.description: Make one explicit I-Digital status request for a message UUID.
